prompt: Create an Angular attribute directive called `appHighlight` that changes the background color of any element on hover. It should accept an optional color input (default yellow) and use the modern `host` metadata approach, not @HostBinding/@HostListener. Make it work with Angular 21 standalone APIs.

assertions.name: uses_input_function
assertions.description: Uses input() function instead of @Input decorator

assertions.name: correct_selector
assertions.description: Uses attribute selector [appHighlight] not element selector

assertions.name: standalone_implicit
assertions.description: Does not explicitly set standalone: true (Angular 21 default)
